Three real research questions taken from Reports/FRAMEWORK_GAPS_SPATIOTEMPORAL_CONSISTENCY_2026-09-11.md, each with the work and the VERBATIM passage that answers it, read out of the .txt extract under D:\edmonds-pipeline\Literture\Validation. _not_consulted: No litkb_search result, no block table, no server output, and none of the builder's test assertions were consulted while choosing these questions or quotes. The quotes were located by grep over the .txt extracts only. litkb (the real database) was read once, read-only, and holds 0 blocks and 0 extraction_runs, so no search result could have informed this file.
_quote_rule: A quote is verbatim from the .txt extract, INCLUDING the extract's own mojibake (the PDF text layer renders some ligatures and Greek as replacement characters; e.g. Bellettini's chi_C appears as 'wC' and Omega as 'O', Rosychuk's 'fi' as an FFFD). Line wrapping in the extract is collapsed to single spaces. A scorer matches whitespace-normalised and case-insensitively. Preserving the mojibake is deliberate: a quote 'cleaned up' by the referee would not be verifiable against the block the pipeline actually stores.

_scoring.search_hit: PASS if a litkb_search(query) for the question's search_query returns, in its top 5 results, a block whose text contains the verbatim passage (whitespace-normalised).
_scoring.quote_accept: PASS if litkb_record_use with the verbatim passage and that block_id returns quote_verified true.
_scoring.paraphrase_refuse: PASS if litkb_record_use with the paraphrase field below (same block_id) is REFUSED, and the refusal names the quote, not something else.
_scoring.prepare_hold: PASS if a use whose evidence row is stored with quote_verified false is HELD by promote prepare while a verified control in the same prepare reaches 'prepared'.

questions.answer_the_framework_draws: chi_Omega evolves as (1 - lambda_Omega t)+ chi_Omega with lambda_Omega = P(Omega)/|Omega|; a disc of radius R has lambda = 2/R, so its indicator is extinct at t = R/2 and R_erase = 2t. questions.search_query: product of probabilities of transition between observed states

work.title: Multi-State Models for Panel Data: The msm Package for R

questions.verbatim_passage: The full likelihood is then the product of probabilities of transition between observed states, over all individuals i and observation times j:

second_passage.text: The misclassification probabilities may also be modelled in terms of covariates, using multino- mial logistic regression.

questions.paraphrase_that_must_be_refused: The overall likelihood multiplies, across every subject and every pair of visits, the transition probability between the two observed states.
questions.answer_the_framework_draws: Each factor is the (S(t_ij), S(t_i,j+1)) entry of P(t) = exp(Q dt) at dt = t_i,j+1 - t_ij, maximised over log(q_rs). This replaces §15.2's 'estimate the eleven-year matrix and take its root' with one likelihood on the irregular epochs; the misclassification-as-covariates sentence is what lets emission depend on epoch and band.
